rationale: Setup always limits at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold (>=+0.07 ns), DRC (final 0) and slew/cap (<=33 vs bar 309) never bind, so push timing. AREA 3 runs show reg-to-reg ~6.1-6.4 ns at any target, ~1 ns faster than DELAY 3/4 (reg-to-reg-limited at 7.3-7.6 ns). Best run (md5, 6.955) is port-path-limited, and port T_eff shrinks with the target (IO delays scale with clock), so pin the minimum period_frac 0.45 (7.02 ns). Final slack tracks the last repair margin (des 0.24 vs 0.25), so high margins aim repair near 6.6 ns. cap213 makes repair land accurately (stock under-repaired aes_cipher). Keep timing-driven placement and post-GRT timing repair, as in md5.
